name: LOCAL
desc: Covers the LOCAL function: sequential lexical TEMP bindings, computed string/number names, null-name current-node overrides, arbitrary return values, nested scopes, restoration after success or trapped failure, original-tree isolation, value-context construction, namespaces, SPLIT metadata, and error/resource propagation. LOCAL returns a constructed value rather than passing its final expression through in match context. Supporting expressions expose LOCAL semantics without enumerating every interaction with other contexts.

tests.name: Return values
tests.desc: LOCAL evaluates its return expression in value context. With no binding pairs it still evaluates and returns that expression. Binding values and returned structures support all JSON types.

tests.name: Binding names
tests.desc: Names are evaluated in value context. Strings name exactly one TEMP root property; numbers are coerced to strings, including fractions and negative values. Dots and slashes do not form paths. Repeated names overwrite the local binding.

tests.name: Computed name from an earlier TEMP binding
Empty string name is distinct from null
Null computed by an expression overrides NODE
Sequential evaluation
tests.desc: Each name and value is evaluated using earlier bindings. An assignment becomes visible only after its value is evaluated, so self-references see the previous binding. NODE overrides take effect for later names, values, and the return expression.

tests.name: Later values see earlier TEMP names
Repeated binding reads the old value
NODE assignment value sees original NODE
Repeated NODE assignments use the current local node
Override NODE from an earlier TEMP value
NODE override to null still exists
Later name and value share the same earlier state
Lexical isolation
tests.desc: Nested overlays inherit other TEMP names, shadow only their own roots, and restore bindings when they exit. Rebinding NODE never writes through to the original input, const, stash, or another TEMP path.

tests.name: Rebinding a root cannot change a saved subtree
NODE alias to TEMP does not replace that TEMP root
New TEMP binding disappears on return
CONST and STASH roots are unchanged
Failed inner scope restores outer TEMP
Failed inner scope restores outer NODE
Editing result cannot change its source
Value and matching contexts
tests.desc: The return expression is evaluated as a value, including boolean results from explicit match expressions. When LOCAL itself is used as a pattern, its returned structure is a literal constructed value. EXPR uses invocation-time lexical bindings.

tests.name: Bare return object constructs its fields
Bare return array constructs its fields
Explicit match result is a boolean
IS compares a returned complete value
Embedded predicate returns a literal boolean
Parsed date can be the local NODE
Returned parsed date exports as text
Returned TEMP array retains SPLIT metadata
Rebound NODE array retains SPLIT metadata
Failures and limits
tests.desc: Invalid evaluated names are INVALID_OPERAND; missing bindings and explicit FAIL are INVALID_TARGET. Malformed arity, invalid nested syntax, and forbidden TEMP-root references remain INVALID_GRAFT. Failure cannot leak lexical bindings. Resource failures remain fatal through match probes.
